summary: The visual-evidence gate fails. The stage figures provide identically framed raw, probability, mask, boundary, centerline, and final-overlay panels for only one plane from each of two specimens, while separate tracking figures omit probability maps, masks, instance boundaries, and final production overlays. Consequently, no artifact supports the required end-to-end comparison through tracking at identical framing. Direct inspection also reveals a visually inconsistent WT wide-track sequence and absent or imperceptible centerlines in both irregular examples. The evidence was generated at commits predating the reviewed commit.

evidence: Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_remediation_stages/KJ-01_z035_stages.png and WT-01_z035_stages.png confirms matching crops for raw image, foreground probability, core probability, filled mask, instance boundaries, measured centerlines, and final overlay.
scripts/generate_v571_stage_evidence.py:46-67 applies one ROI crop to every displayed stage.

audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png and WT-01_stratified_tracking.png display raw crops and centerlines only; they do not show probability maps, filled masks, instance boundaries, or final overlays at the same framing.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:167-200 renders an unobscured raw panel followed only by raw images with centerline-label overlays.
scripts/generate_v571_stage_evidence.py:49-56 renders segmentation stages but contains no track identity or cross-plane panels.
Direct inspection of both post-audit run3 tracking figures shows one-pixel colored centerlines that generally leave surrounding raw geometry visible.

scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:113-122 replaces only centerline-label pixels with the track color; scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:217-220 explicitly identifies these marks as one-pixel centerlines.
Direct inspection of both remediation-stage figures shows thin final-overlay centerlines rather than opaque filled annotations.
The whole-slice stage figures are too densely populated for reliable object-level adjudication of missed nuclei, merged neighbors, false splits, or boundary leakage.

The touching-object rows in audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png and WT-01_stratified_tracking.png lack corresponding probability, filled-mask, core, and instance-boundary crops, so the apparent neighbor separation cannot be verified.
No representative object-level panels combine raw data, probability maps, parent/filled masks, instance boundaries, and centerlines for adjudicating merges or splits.

Direct inspection of the wide row in audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/WT-01_stratified_tracking.png shows the colored geometry changing from a long left-hand structure at z046-z047 to a small central fragment at z048 and a separate right-hand structure at z049; the figure does not visually establish continuous identity.
audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/tracking_evidence_manifest.json assigns all displayed wide-row observations to WT-01 track_id 1731 and reports observations spanning z38-z57.

scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:190-200 colors labels from the tabular track assignment without independently demonstrating that the changing structures share biological identity.

audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/tracking_evidence_manifest.json and both associated tracking figures include labeled faint, bright, short, long, wide, curved, touching, and irregular categories.

Direct inspection of the irregular rows in both KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png and WT-01_stratified_tracking.png shows no clearly visible colored target centerline in any displayed observation, despite the manifest listing four observed planes for each irregular track.

The required categories are selected by extrema rather than independently annotated representativeness: scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:78-100 ranks tracks numerically and takes the first unused finite candidate.

findings.title: No end-to-end identically framed visual chain includes tracking
findings.impact: The claim's segmentation, instance separation, measurement geometry, and track assignment cannot be visually traced as one auditable chain. Misses, leakage, false splits, and cross-plane merges therefore remain unresolved.
evidence: scripts/generate_v571_stage_evidence.py:49-56 stops at a single-plane final overlay.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:167-200 shows only raw images and centerline overlays for tracking.
audits/evidence/v571_remediation_stages/*.png and audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/*.png are separate figure families with different crops and content.
findings.recommendation: Generate object-level, identically framed panels for each required category and consecutive plane, showing raw image, foreground/core probability, filled parent mask, instance boundaries, centerline, track identity, and final overlay together.

findings.title: WT wide-track identity is visually inconsistent
findings.impact: A putative track appears to jump between geometrically distinct structures across adjacent planes, undermining the claim that track identity is preserved and impossible joins are rejected.
evidence: Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/WT-01_stratified_tracking.png, wide row, z046-z049.
audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/tracking_evidence_manifest.json identifies the row as WT-01 track_id 1731 with observations from z38 through z57.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile track 1731 against instance masks and coordinates. Provide a zoomed consecutive-plane audit with stable spatial framing, boundaries, instance IDs, link edges, calibrated displacement, and overlap/support evidence; correct the tracker if the join is invalid.

findings.title: Irregular examples do not visibly demonstrate their target geometry
findings.impact: The required irregular-object coverage is nominal rather than visually auditable, so identity and measurement preservation for irregular morphology remain unverified.
evidence: Direct inspection of the irregular rows in audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/KJ-01_stratified_tracking.png and WT-01_stratified_tracking.png finds no clearly discernible colored centerline.
audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/tracking_evidence_manifest.json nevertheless lists four displayed and observed planes for each irregular record.
scripts/generate_v571_stratified_tracking_evidence.py:86-89 defines irregularity using a composite numeric ranking rather than a reviewed morphology annotation.
findings.recommendation: Select independently annotated irregular objects, confirm their centerline labels are nonempty, and render a color/contrast-safe zoom with masks, boundaries, and track identity visible on every observed plane.

findings.title: Visual artifacts do not attest the reviewed commit
findings.impact: Changes between artifact-generation commits and the reviewed commit are not visually validated; acceptance of the exact candidate would rely on inference.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_remediation_stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json records fa69c83606c0ebe65b74f11af129cdba8394af17.
audits/evidence/v571_post_audit_remediation_run3/tracking_evidence_manifest.json records 8c1f9f53e4a1ab72e66a82ef31b8c675ab9e4bf9.
Reviewed HEAD command result: 5bb5a836e30ed0a8b4f6644e3e5f30d680f6ad4e.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate the focused visual-evidence suite from the reviewed commit and record artifact, source, generator, profile, checkpoint, and commit hashes.

findings.title: Whole-slice stage panels are insufficient for adjudicating object-level errors
findings.impact: Dense full-ROI displays can conceal missed faint nuclei, boundary leakage, touching-object merges, and false splits even though all pipeline stages are present.
evidence: Direct inspection of audits/evidence/v571_remediation_stages/KJ-01_z035_stages.png and WT-01_z035_stages.png shows hundreds of small objects in whole-ROI panels.
Their manifest reports 283 and 257 detections respectively, making individual boundary and centerline comparisons impractical at the rendered scale.
findings.recommendation: Supplement whole-ROI context with fixed-scale object crops selected across the required morphology and intensity strata, including challenging negatives and independently annotated expected outcomes.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as prohibited by the review instructions.
Source TIFFs and analysis-output tables referenced by the manifests reside at external absolute paths and were not available within the repository for independent raw-to-artifact reconstruction.
Assessment of identity inconsistency is visual; the repository artifacts do not include link-edge coordinates or identically framed masks needed for a definitive forensic reconstruction.
Other reviewers' outputs were not read.
recommended_follow_up: Regenerate commit-matched visual artifacts after resolving or explaining WT-01 track 1731.
Add end-to-end object-level panels for faint, bright, short, long, curved, wide, touching, and independently annotated irregular objects.
Add explicit adversarial examples for a missed faint nucleus, touching-neighbor separation, false-split risk, boundary leakage, and an impossible cross-plane join.
Require automated evidence checks that every displayed observed plane has a nonempty target centerline and that manifested commit and artifact hashes match the acceptance candidate.
